results.name: oracle: our accessible names and roles agree with Chromium's accessibility tree in all 40 modules × 3 layouts (thresholds declared up front: names ≥ 98 %, roles ≥ 99 %)
oracle sensitivity: three mutants of the narrator source are caught (aria-label ignored → names < 98 %; buttons as generic → roles < 99 %; CSS text-transform ignored → the uppercase headings differ)

behaviour: the toggle chord turns Narrator on (spoken + captioned + saved); Tab focus is announced with name and role and the cursor box surrounds the focused element; entering a window announces its dialog context; typing is echoed
behaviour: live regions — a polite status is queued without interrupting, an assertive alert interrupts (cancel before speak); aria-busy holds back; Ctrl alone stops speech

behaviour: Narrator key + H / Shift+H / Right move the cursor through the focused window (headings, items) without moving focus; W says where you are; = speeds up (saved, next utterance faster); F1 lists commands and Esc returns focus; captions-only mode stops speech but keeps captions
behaviour: the toggle chord turns Narrator off (says so, captions and cursor disappear, saved); the Mac preset uses Cmd+F5; the Settings checkbox reflects and drives the same setting
